title: Workshop: build a product card
summary: Frame, round, fill and light a product card step by step: borders, radius, gradients, layered backgrounds, shadows and focus rings.
intro: a product card with a gradient image area, a badge, a button and a footer. The HTML is already written (see the html tab). Each step adds one edge or background treatment: a border, rounded corners, gradients, a dotted layer, shadows, a divider and a focus ring.
